_doc: B5 service commands. Selected because config/hosts/b5.json names this file. Same shape as service-commands.json: cmd+args+cwd spawns a process, skip = externally managed.
_ollama-doc: Normally Ollama.app owns :11434 (menu-bar app). When it does, the manager ADOPTS that process — status shows it as external, Stop kills it, Restart hands it over to a manager-spawned `ollama serve` with the env below. When nothing holds the port, Start spawns it directly. OLLAMA_HOST pins it to loopback; nothing on this box is tunnelled.
_local-ai-doc: One loopback adapter exposes the already-installed LocalAI toolkit to Hangar. It does not load weights at startup; Draw Things and MLX models load per request and the toolkit lock prevents concurrent heavy jobs.
